registers.note: the model names widget +0x71f00 MGRAS_XMAP_DIB_OFF (the XMAP digital input bypass, CRS(6)|DW4 = 0x300 on MGRAS_XMAP_BASE) and implements no handler for it; every /unix accessor that computes the address is a timing/palette function (MgrasSetTiming, MgrasSetXMAPTiming, MgrasSetColors, MgrasInitXMAP, MgrasCalcScreenSize, MgrasSyncPPRDRAMs). The kernel witness therefore does NOT refute the model's name: on the traced path 100% of writes to this address follow a write to the XMAP INDEX port +0x71c88 with per-DID index values, which is exactly the indexed CRS shape the model documents. Index-before-data is necessary and NOT sufficient (+0x71c08 PP1_SELECT passes the same test and cannot be per-DID), and mgrashw.h -- which the model cites by line for every CRS number -- is not held by the project. So: field SEMANTICS UNGROUNDED, the model's name NOT refuted.

index_before_data.note: +0x71c08 PP1_SELECT under the same test: 37/113 writes preceded by an index write, so index-before-data is necessary and NOT sufficient for a per-DID register
